1.consolidated_definition: mod. Calzoncillo, pantalón. Tipo de calzón normalmente de algodón, similar al que utilizan los boxeadores. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Nada es mejor que usar el tradicional calzoncillo boxer que no aprieta ni sirve de obligado sostén a las partes más delicadas del hombre (El Expresso de Puerto Rico, 25-01-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Boxer shorts, boxer pant. Type of loose-fitting cotton pants similar to those used by boxers. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Nothing is better than using the traditional boxer short that neither constricts nor serves as an obligatory support for a man's most delicate areas (The Expresso de Puerto Rico, 25-01-07)
